latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides automated audits of study habits and training designs for evidence-based learning effectiveness.

- Detects five major ineffective learning patterns: rereading trap, massed practice delusion, illusions of knowing cluster, learning styles myth, errorless learning myth.
- Gathers detailed descriptions of current study or training practices using targeted intake questions.
- Classifies each detected anti-pattern by name, severity, and underlying psychological mechanism.
- Explains why each pattern feels productive, but leads to weak retention.
- Directly routes users to corrective skills for proven alternatives.
- Produces a structured audit report, prioritizing findings by impact.
